conclusion.canonical: Official municipal reporting supports that emergency response continued across several Kyiv districts and that fifteen injuries were reported, with nine people said to remain hospitalized; the casualty totals lack independent corroboration in the frozen evidence.

Secondary reporting attributed to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticism of delayed air-defence deliveries and requests for additional air-defence support and sanctions; the underlying primary publication was not frozen, so the attributions are probable rather than directly confirmed.
